channel.title: media-curator - podcasts
channel.description: Weekly podcast picks, chosen against a taste profile that learns.

item.title: Building the Context Flywheel for AI Data Agents
item.description: Metadata and warehouse context as the thing that makes a data agent work or fail, discussed as an interview - it survives background listening rather than demanding full attention.

item.title: Rift Wizard 3: Interview with Developer Dylan White
item.description: A frontier probe - a solo developer walking through concrete design and tooling decisions (Python/Pygame prototyping, an items system, encounter pressure) relevant to solo game-dev side projects in general.

item.title: Pierre Mazeaud, un alpiniste sur l'île de l'enfer
item.description: A deliberate discovery rather than an episode from an already-subscribed show - same French narrative-outdoor register as other favorites in the genre. A few months old but inside the freshness band.
